new_theorem.statement: If X is independent of (Y,Z), p_X<=1, p_(Y,Z)<=H, and T=2sXY+aY^2+fZ^2 with sf nonzero, then ||p_T||_infinity <= 6 H^(2/3)|s^2 f|^(-1/3).
new_theorem.application: In an exact rank-three exact null-coloop, the residual 2D product projection has joint density cap e and det M=-s^2 f, hence ||p_Q||_infinity <=6e^(2/3)|det M|^(-1/3)<11.687. This is uniform in the residual determinant and requires no residual leverage assumption.

named_partner_applied.use: Its remaining near-unit alternative c>61/64 included c=1. The new theorem pays c=1 unconditionally, leaving the punctured 61/64<c<1 endpoint family on that route.

other_dependency.use: 2D orthonormal product projection density cap e.

guard: True independence of the original scalar from the whole pair is essential. Pair-density cap plus conditional scalar-density cap alone is insufficient: W=-Z^2/(2Y)+U makes 2WY+Z^2=2UY logarithmically singular.
remaining_scope: For 61/64<c<1, retain original-product provenance of the nonzero complement longitudinal form; coefficient smallness cannot be treated as perturbative. The partner high-normalized-leverage c<=61/64 branch and arbitrary-additional-spectrum descent remain separately open.
continuity: OPEN_GLOBALLY; new theorem establishes essential boundedness only
